topic: What would happen if oxygen levels doubled?

scenario.title: Double Oxygen: Your Lungs COLLAPSE in Seconds!
scenario.clickbait_title: DOUBLE OXYGEN: Your Lungs WILL FAIL in Seconds!
scenario.thumbnail_concept: A chaotic city street engulfed in impossible, rapidly spreading blue-white flames, high contrast, vertical composition. A terrified person's silhouette is visible in the foreground, running.
scenario.seo_description: What if oxygen levels doubled overnight? Your world would ignite instantly, but that's just the beginning. Roli, the time-traveling rabbit scientist, reveals the terrifying truth about double oxygen. Discover why your lungs would fail.

scenes.narration: The air just became liquid fire. Every spark ignites instantly, uncontrollably. Your city burns in seconds. But that's not the worst part.
scenes.visual_prompt: A vertical 9:16 shot of a chaotic, modern city street engulfed in impossible, rapidly spreading blue-white flames. Buildings are melting and crumbling. People are running in terror, blurred motion. High contrast, dramatic cinematic lighting, photorealistic, 8K detail. Focus on the overwhelming scale of the fire.
scenes.twist_element: The open loop: 'But that's not the worst part.' implying something even more terrifying.

scenes.narration: Roli, the time-traveling rabbit, warns this oxygen surge hyper-charges all life. Insects grow monstrous. Plants explode with growth. You feel powerful, but your body oxidizes rapidly. Yet, even that isn't the true danger.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Roli, a steampunk rabbit scientist, stands in a lush, hyper-green, overgrown jungle, pointing urgently at a massive, bioluminescent dragonfly or spider. Close up on Roli looking alarmed. Then a quick cut to a stylized, photorealistic visual of a human cell rapidly oxidizing, showing cellular damage. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail.
scenes.twist_element: The open loop: 'Yet, even that isn't the true danger.' hinting at a deeper, hidden threat.

scenes.narration: The real horror? The air is too dense. Your lungs can’t handle the pressure; they fail. You gasp, drowning in too much life, as the fires still rage, turning the world into liquid fire.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. First-person perspective (POV) of someone gasping for air, clutching their chest, hands shaking. The surroundings are an impossibly lush, overgrown, hyper-saturated green jungle. Distant, glowing blue-white fires are visible through the dense foliage, creating an oppressive, claustrophobic atmosphere. Dramatic, urgent lighting, photorealistic, 8K detail.
scenes.twist_element: The final twist: The air density, not just fire or oxidation, is the ultimate killer. The ending loops back to the 'liquid fire' imagery from Scene 1.
